name: Monk Lone Wolf
body:
A lone wolf monk follows his own values and is not subject to anyone. He could have been expelled from a school, or could have decided that his master’s teachings were too harsh or short–sighted. A lone wolf could in fact still belong to another way; for example, he could be the only survivor of his school, or strive to found his own splinter tradition.

Becoming a Lone Wolf: Normally, when a monk wishes to change his way, he must undergo a lengthy process that requires him to adhere to the edicts of his new way for a period of time before receiving any benefits. This is not the case with a lone wolf. Once a monk decides to become a lone wolf, he immediately loses all of the bonuses, skills, and abilities of his old way and gains those of the lone wolf way. If he wishes to stop being a lone wolf and dedicate himself to another way, he must do so using the normal rules.

Ethics: Always do what you think is right. Be faithful to yourself. Serve no master, and pledge allegiance to people more than causes.

Alignment: A lone wolf monk may have any alignment.

Charismatic Stranger (Ex)

A lone wolf monk uses Charisma instead of Wisdom to determine the effects of all his monk class features. If he ever abandons this way, he loses access to all his monk abilities until he gains a new level.

Resolve (Ex)

At 4th level, a lone wolf gains the resolve samurai ability. Each use of this ability costs him 3 ki points. This replaces the 4th and 8th-level ki powers.

Greater Resolve (Ex)

At 12th level, the lone wolf gains greater resolve. This replaces the 12th and 16th-level ki powers.

Perfect Resolve: At 20th level, a lone wolf becomes a magical creature. He is forevermore treated as an outsider rather than as a humanoid (or whatever his creature type was) for the purpose of spells and magical effects. Additionally, the lone wolf gains the samurai’s true resolve ability. Unlike other outsiders, the monk can still be brought back from the dead as if he were a member of his previous creature type. This modifies perfect self and replaces the 20th-level ki power.
